lines.en: label saradate10:
I tap on Sara’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Sara 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: It’s relatively windy out today, but that doesn’t stop me from wanting to wander around outside for a bit.
lines.zh: 今天风挺大的，但这不妨碍我想出去逛一会儿。

lines.en: And if there is anyone I know who likes wandering around the city with me (And routinely stopping to buy candy because she is a child trapped in a woman’s body), it’s Sara.
lines.zh: 要说认识的人里有谁喜欢陪我在城里乱逛（而且还要时不时停下来买糖，因为她就是个困在女人身体里的小孩），那就是 Sara。

lines.en: But hey, if a few stops at convenience stores are all it takes to be seen in public with an attractive woman that’s actually close to my age...
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，只要多停几站便利店，就能和一个年纪跟我相仿的美女一起出现在公共场合……

lines.en: I guess that’s a price I’m willing to pay.
lines.zh: 我想这个代价我付得起。

lines.en: : Mmn...hello?...
: Hey. You’re not just waking up now, are you?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你不会刚睡醒吧？

lines.en: : What time is it?...
lines.zh: : 现在几点了？……

lines.en: : It’s a little past noon.
lines.zh: : 刚过中午一点。

lines.en: : Ngh...
: I drank too much last night...
lines.zh: : 我昨晚喝太多了……

lines.en: : Yeah, that sounds on-brand.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这很符合你的风格。

lines.en: : Want to subject yourself to sensory overload and go walk around the urban district for a little while?
lines.zh: : 要不要让自己接受一下感官超载，去市区逛一会儿？

lines.en: : Mnh...when?
lines.zh: : 嗯……什么时候？

lines.en: : Like, now.
lines.zh: : 就现在。

lines.en: : Guh...okaaaaay.
: I’ll start getting ready...
lines.zh: : 我开始准备了……

lines.en: Sara hangs up and I begin to make my way to the same huge office building we normally meet at when we decide to visit that part of town.
lines.zh: Sara 挂了电话，我开始往那栋巨大的写字楼走——只要我俩约在这一带见面，通常都约在那儿。

lines.en: Knowing that it will likely be a while until she gets there, I stop for coffee at a nearby cafe (One without any [[confirmed] manga club members working) and pick something up for Sara as well.
lines.zh: 知道她大概得过一阵才到，我就在附近一家咖啡厅买了咖啡（一家没有[[confirmed]漫画社成员打工的店），顺便也给 Sara 带了一杯。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard1
Unfortunately, she is one of those cowards who is incapable of drinking black coffee, so I wind up consuming two drinks instead of one.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，她属于那种喝不了黑咖啡的胆小鬼，所以最后两杯都进了我的肚子。

lines.en: That’s fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过无所谓。

lines.en: Caffeine is one of those drugs that you can’t overdose on.
lines.zh: 咖啡因是那种怎么都喝不死人的毒品。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: And, even in the event that I somehow did, she’ll be here to call an ambulance.
lines.zh: 而且就算我真喝过量了，她也在场，可以帮忙叫救护车。

lines.en: I’m sure today will proceed just fine with all of that in mind.
lines.zh: 有这些前提，我相信今天会一切顺利。

lines.en: : You look really good for someone battling a hangover right now.
lines.zh: : 对一个正在和宿醉搏斗的人来说，你气色还真不错。

lines.en: : Thanks~
lines.zh: : 谢谢~

lines.en: : The trick is to just drink more as soon as you wake up so your brain can go back to feeling good.
lines.zh: : 诀窍就是一醒来就再喝点，这样脑子就又能舒服起来了。

lines.en: : That’s not a trick, that’s alcoholism.
lines.zh: : 那不是诀窍，那是酒精中毒。

lines.en: : I just call it having a good time.
lines.zh: : 我管这叫享受人生。

lines.en: : That is also alcoholism.
lines.zh: : 那也是酒精中毒。

lines.en: : You have a problem.
lines.zh: : 你有病。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard2
: I do not! It’s not like I do this every morning, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我才没有！我又不是每天早上都这样，Sensei。

lines.en: : I just got a call from Haru-chan really late last night because she was feeling all lonely again.
lines.zh: : 昨晚很晚的时候 Haru 酱打电话给我，说她又觉得特别孤单。

lines.en: : So the two of us did what any good friends would do and got drunk on the phone and cried to each other about all kinds of stuff.
lines.zh: : 于是我俩做了任何好朋友都会做的事——在电话里一起喝醉，然后对着彼此哭诉各种事情。

lines.en: : I’m kind of glad I don’t have any friends as close as that. That sounds horrible.
lines.zh: 我有点庆幸自己没有亲近到那种程度的朋友。听起来太可怕了。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
scene saranikiboard3
: That’s not true. I’m your friend, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 才不是呢。我是你的朋友呀，Sensei~

lines.en: : And I think we’re plenty close.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得我们已经够亲近了。

lines.en: : So close that you get to stick it in me while my daughter is downstairs. Isn’t that great?
lines.zh: : 亲近到趁我女儿在楼下的时候，你还能把它插进来。是不是很棒？

lines.en: : For us? Yes. For your daughter? No.
lines.zh: : 对我们来说？是。对你女儿来说？不是。

lines.en: : Well I think it’s great.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我觉得很棒啊。

lines.en: : Don't you think it’s like...about time we told her, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你不觉得……差不多该告诉她了吗？

lines.en: : At least that way, we probably wouldn’t have to worry about her walking in on us.
lines.zh: : 至少那样的话，我们大概就不用再担心她撞见我俩了。

lines.en: : I prefer to keep my relationships secret, if you don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 如果你不介意的话，我更希望把这种关系藏着。

lines.en: : Especially from people as pure as Sana.
lines.zh: : 尤其是对 Sana 那么纯洁的人。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard4
: Oh, please. She’s a growing girl. I’m sure she gets up to all sorts of stuff while she’s alone.
lines.zh: : 拜托。她正是一个正在长大的女孩。我敢说她一个人的时候什么都可能干。

lines.en: : Take that back. I will not allow you to tarnish that girl’s image.
lines.zh: : 把话收回去。我不允许你玷污那孩子在我心里的形象。

lines.en: : I’m just saying, I know I did when I was her age.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，我在她那个年纪的时候可没少干。

lines.en: : But I was also having sex with my teacher when I was her age, soooo...
lines.zh: : 不过我在她那个年纪也正和老师上床，所——以……

lines.en: : Maybe I just have a thing for teachers?
lines.zh: : 说不定我就是对老师有感觉？

lines.en: else:
scene saranikiboard5
: That’s not true, Sensei. I think we’re plenty close.
lines.zh: : 才不是那样，Sensei。我觉得我们已经够亲近了。

lines.en: : Even if you won’t accept my love.
lines.zh: : 就算你不肯接受我的爱。

lines.en: : I’ve accepted it. I just can’t return it.
lines.zh: : 我已经接受了。只是没法回应而已。

lines.en: : Yeah, that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就是那个。

lines.en: : But if you ever feel like calling me in the middle of the night to get drunk and cry, I’ll always be there. Kay?
lines.zh: : 不过要是你哪天半夜想打电话给我，一起喝醉一起哭，我随时都在。好不好？

lines.en: : This is not a thing I will ever want. But thanks, Sara.
lines.zh: : 这种事我永远都不会想要。不过还是谢谢你，Sara。

lines.en: : Of course~
lines.zh: : 不客气~

lines.en: scene saranikiboard6
: Though, I suppose at this point you’d rather just call my daughter and talk to her instead, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，事到如今你大概更想打电话给我女儿、跟她聊天吧？

lines.en: : I’m not quite sure what you’re insinuating with that.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定你这是在暗示什么。

lines.en: : Just that she’s getting awfully warmed up to you out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 只是觉得她莫名其妙地就跟你亲近起来了。

lines.en: : Maybe on account of you visiting her dorm room at night?
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你晚上会去她宿舍找她？

lines.en: scene saranikiboard7
: Maybe if I was still her size...
lines.zh: : 要是我还是她那么小的话……

lines.en: : Okay, anyway, why don’t we talk about something else?
lines.zh: : 好了好了，我们换个话题吧？

lines.en: : Embrace my youthful jealousy, Sensei...Embrace it~
lines.zh: : 拥抱我这股年轻的嫉妒吧，Sensei……拥抱它~

lines.en: : It’s less of a youth thing and more of an...innocence thing.
lines.zh: : 与其说是年轻，不如说是……纯洁的问题。

lines.en: : And even then, nothing like that is even close to happening between Sana and me.
lines.zh: : 而且就算那样，我和 Sana 之间也远远没到那种地步。

lines.en: : But...if the opportunity arose...
lines.zh: : 不过……要是有机会的话……

lines.en: : Come on. If there’s anyone who knows what teachers like you think about in their spare time, it’s me.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。要说有谁知道像你这样的老师闲下来会想些什么，那就是我了。

lines.en: : I was barely a freshman when I started sleeping with mine.
lines.zh: : 我开始和自己的老师睡觉的时候，才刚上高一。

lines.en: It’s crazy right now to think of Sana doing anything remotely close to what Sara was doing back then.
lines.zh: 现在想想，Sana 会做出哪怕一点点接近当年 Sara 那种事，都会让人觉得离谱。

lines.en: Will that stop me from thinking about it? Of course not.
lines.zh: 这就能阻止我去想吗？当然不能。

lines.en: My mind lands on that almost every time I walk into her room.
lines.zh: 几乎每次走进她的房间，我的脑子都会落在那上面。

lines.en: But it’s just so far out of reach at this point that I don’t even bother addressing it.
lines.zh: 只是事到如今那实在太遥不可及，我连正视都懒得正视。

lines.en: Sara, though-
lines.zh: 可 Sara 就不一样了——

lines.en: Those experiences went on to shape the rest of her life.
lines.zh: 那些经历塑造了她往后的人生。

lines.en: A lot of people say that the first few years of a child’s life are what go on to sculpt them as a person.
lines.zh: 很多人说，塑造一个人的是童年最初那几年。

lines.en: I don’t think I agree with that.
lines.zh: 我不太同意。

lines.en: I think that people tend to find themselves in their[teen]years- particularly their years in [high_school].
lines.zh: 我觉得人往往是在[teen]那几年找到自我的——尤其是念 [high_school] 的那几年。

lines.en: Which is why I’m so worried about how everyone I know will eventually break down and die.
lines.zh: 所以我才这么担心，我认识的这些人最终会怎样崩溃、怎样死去。

lines.en: And how I, too, will become the man who abandoned Sara and her family.
lines.zh: 也担心我自己，终有一天也会变成那个抛弃 Sara 和她家人的男人。

lines.en: : Do you regret it at all?
lines.zh: : 你一点都不后悔吗？

lines.en: scene saranikiboard8
: What? Sleeping with my teacher?
lines.zh: : 什么？和老师上床？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Hmm...I guess I do sometimes.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概有时候会吧。

lines.en: : I definitely loved him.
lines.zh: : 我确实是爱过他的。

lines.en: : But now I have an adorable little girl who’s going to wind up becoming a better version of me when she's older. And that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 可现在我有个可爱的小女儿，她长大后会变成比我更好的版本。这样也挺好的。

lines.en: : Besides, even if he wound up being unfaithful, I needed someone like that back then.
lines.zh: : 再说，就算他最后背叛了我，那时候的我确实需要那样一个人。

lines.en: : Have you always been this-
lines.zh: : 你一直都这么——

lines.en: : Needy?
lines.zh: : 缺爱吗？

lines.en: scene saranikiboard9
: Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’d say so.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我会这么说。

lines.en: : I was kind of like an...anti-Sana when I was in [high_school].
lines.zh: : 我念 [high_school] 的时候，有点像是……反过来的 Sana。

lines.en: : Instead of closing myself off from everyone, I chose to stay wide open instead.
lines.zh: : 我没有把自己对所有人关上，而是选择了彻底敞开。

lines.en: : I would have let anyone in regardless of who they were or what they wanted from me.
lines.zh: : 不管对方是谁、想从我这儿得到什么，我都会放他们进来。

lines.en: : And I wound up falling for the first person to ever look at me as a girl.
lines.zh: : 于是我最后爱上了第一个把我当女孩子看的人。

lines.en: : Well, the first older person at least.
lines.zh: : 至少是第一个年长的人。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard10
: There were plenty of boys who liked me back then, but I never really had any interest in them since they were all just kids.
lines.zh: : 那时候喜欢我的男生有很多，可我对他们一点兴趣都没有，因为他们都只是小孩。

lines.en: : Like, what could they do for me that I couldn’t do for myself?
lines.zh: : 比如说，他们能为我做什么我自己做不到的事？

lines.en: : Well, you just wanted to feel loved, right? That’s what you’re making it sound like.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你只是想被爱，对吧？听起来像是这样。

lines.en: : I think “protected” is a little closer to what I was looking for.
lines.zh: : 我觉得「被保护」更接近我当时想要的东西。

lines.en: : It would make me happy when I’d get a confession from a boy, but none of them would ever make me feel as safe as someone older with more...power and stuff.
lines.zh: : 被男生表白我会开心，但他们谁都没法让我觉得安心——比不上一个年长的、拥有更多……权力和那种东西的人。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard11
: Which is probably one more reason I like you so much.
lines.zh: : 这大概也是我这么喜欢你的又一个理由。

lines.en: : The only power I have is determining whether a handful of [teenage]girls will make it through their first year of [high_school] or not.
lines.zh: : 我唯一的权力，就是决定那么几个[teenage]女孩能不能熬过 [high_school] 一年级。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard12
: You’ve got a lot more power than that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你的权力可比那大多了，Sensei。

lines.en: : You have an entire class of girls who look up to you and learn from you.
lines.zh: : 你有整整一个班的女生仰视你、向你学习。

lines.en: : And with barely any men around, you’re pretty much the only male figure they have in their lives.
lines.zh: : 而且周围几乎没有男人，你基本就是她们生命里唯一的男性形象。

lines.en: : Given those kinds of circumstances, I think it’s pretty miraculous you’re as decent as you are.
lines.zh: : 在这样的环境下，你还能正派到这个程度，我觉得已经算是奇迹了。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard13
: If only the same could have been said about Sana’s dad...
lines.zh: : 要是 Sana 她爸也能这么说就好了……

lines.en: : I take it he was one of those people who abused his position?
lines.zh: : 听你的意思，他是那种滥用自己地位的人？

lines.en: scene saranikiboard14
: Will you think I’m dumb or gullible if I say he was?
lines.zh: : 如果我说他是，你会觉得我又蠢又好骗吗？

lines.en: : I think you’re dumb and gullible now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你现在就又蠢又好骗。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard15
: Hey!
: I’m kidding...
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的……

lines.en: Kind of.
lines.zh: : 一半一半。

lines.en: : Of course I won’t think that.
lines.zh: : 我当然不会那么想。

lines.en: : I don’t know what things were like for you when you were that age, and I don’t know what must have been going through your mind in order to deal with that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在那个年纪经历过什么，也不知道你当时得在心里想些什么才能撑过来。

lines.en: : But it’s not crazy to believe someone would have taken advantage of you in the position.
lines.zh: : 但相信有人会利用那种身份占你便宜，一点也不疯狂。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard16
: Good recovery. I like you again.
lines.zh: : 圆得不错。我重新喜欢你了。

lines.en: : Good. Those ten seconds you didn’t were really suspenseful.
lines.zh: : 很好。你刚才那十秒钟不喜欢我的时候，真是紧张死人。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard17
: Heheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Either way, what’s done is done.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，过去的就过去了。

lines.en: : All things considered, I think I’m in a pretty good place now.
lines.zh: : 总的来说，我觉得自己现在过得还不错。

lines.en: : I own a business.
lines.zh: : 我有自己的生意。

lines.en: : That’s failing.
lines.zh: : 正在倒闭。

lines.en: : I have a nice apartment.
lines.zh: : 我有一个不错的公寓。

lines.en: : That you live by yourself in and are likely overpaying for.
lines.zh: : 你一个人住着，而且很可能付了冤枉钱。

lines.en: : And I have the cutest daughter in the world.
lines.zh: : 我还有全世界最可爱的女儿。

lines.en: : Who can’t hold a conversation to save her life.
lines.zh: : 一个连聊天都聊不下去的女儿。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard15
: You’re mean today! Let me have something!
lines.zh: : 你今天好刻薄！给我留点东西吧！

lines.en: : You have my arm. Any more and you’ll start getting ahead of yourself.
lines.zh: : 你已经有我的胳膊了。再多的话，你就得寸进尺了。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard11
: Oh ho ho~ Are you saying I get to keep this arm all to myself?
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵~ 你是说这条胳膊归我一个人了？

lines.en: : Sure. For now.
lines.zh: : 当然。目前是。

lines.en: : I do want something in return, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实想要点回报。

lines.en: : Ooooh? Do we need to go somewhere a little more private, [saramaster]?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？那我们是不是得去个更私密点的地方，[saramaster]？

lines.en: : It’s nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 不是那回事。

lines.en: : I just want you to tell me more of your story sometime.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望哪天你能多讲讲你的故事。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard18
: I’m obviously not going to call you at 2:00AM to get drunk and cry, but I’d like to hear more about how you wound up where you are now.
lines.zh: : 我显然不会凌晨两点打电话给你一起喝醉一起哭，但我想多听听你是怎么走到今天这一步的。

lines.en: : I know surprisingly little about you for a girl who is allegedly “wide open.”
lines.zh: : 对于一个据说「彻底敞开」的女人，我对你了解得少得惊人。

lines.en: I’m also sure that figuring out what makes Sara tick is sure to help me grow a little closer to Sana as well.
lines.zh: 我也相信，搞懂 Sara 到底是怎么运转的，肯定也能帮我跟 Sana 更亲近一些。

lines.en: And, even if it doesn’t, I’m interested in seeing how things got to this point.
lines.zh: 就算没用，我也想知道事情是怎么走到这一步的。

lines.en: And how I might possibly be able to avoid forcing that onto anyone else in the future.
lines.zh: 以及我将来要怎样才能不再把这种事强加给别人。

lines.en: : Do you want to get married?
lines.zh: : 你想结婚吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : No?
lines.zh: : 不想？

lines.en: scene saranikiboard19
: Heheh~ Just checking...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 随便问问……

lines.en: : I’d love to tell you more of my story sometime.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意哪天多讲讲我的故事。

lines.en: : And I’d love to hear yours as well.
lines.zh: : 我也很想听听你的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t know if-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不知道能不能——

lines.en: scene saranikiboard20
: Oh! Here’s a good place to start now!
lines.zh: : 哦！这儿就是个不错的起点！

lines.en: scene saranikiboard21
Sara lets go of my arm and skips over to a local concert hall, displaying a gigantic billboard of-
lines.zh: Sara 松开我的胳膊，蹦跳着跑到本地一家音乐厅前，那儿挂着一块巨大的广告牌，上面是——

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 嗯哦。

lines.en: : When I was a little girl, I wanted to be just like that one day.
lines.zh: : 我小时候曾经希望，有一天自己也能变成那样。

lines.en: : Someone the entire world would gaze at with envy.
lines.zh: : 一个全世界都会羡慕地仰望的人。

lines.en: : A person that boys would adore and that girls would look up to.
lines.zh: : 一个男生会爱慕、女生会崇拜的人。

lines.en: : But now I’m washed up and emotionally spent before even hitting the middle of my thirties.
lines.zh: : 可现在，我还没到三十五岁就已经过气、把感情耗光了。

lines.en: : Do you like girls like that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢那种女生吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : They make your heart race, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 她们让你心跳加速，对吧？

lines.en: scene saranikiboard22
: Or maybe they make you feel a little something else?
lines.zh: : 还是说，她们让你心里起了点别的感觉？

lines.en: : Doesn’t seeing that cute girl up there make you want to just grab her and corrupt-
lines.zh: : 看到上面那个可爱的女孩，你就不想一把抓住她、把她带坏——

lines.en: scene saranikiboard23
scene saranikiboard24
: Why aren’t you saying anything?
lines.zh: : 你怎么不说话？

lines.en: : Don’t tell me that...you wanted to look like that one day, too?...
lines.zh: : 该不会……你自己也曾希望有一天变成那样吧？……

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : Is my ex-girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 是我前女友。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard25
: Oh, come on! Like I’d ever believe that you dated Niki.
lines.zh: : 拜托！我怎么可能信你跟 Niki 交往过。

lines.en: : She’s like...an icon in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 她可是……Kumon-mi 的偶像级人物啊。

lines.en: : I don’t really follow idols the way I used to, but she’s on TV all the time and...
lines.zh: : 我现在不像以前那样追偶像了，可她天天都在电视上出现，而且……

lines.en: : And you still haven’t told me you’re kidding yet...
lines.zh: : 而且你还没告诉我你是在开玩笑……

lines.en: scene saranikiboard26
: What are you-
lines.zh: : 你在干——

lines.en: scene saranikiboard27
: What are you doing? I have no idea who-
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？我根本不认识什么——

lines.en: : Haven’t I told you not to call me in the middle of the day before?! I’m fucking busy!
lines.zh: : 我不是说过别在大白天打电话给我吗？！我他妈正忙着呢！

lines.en: scene saranikiboard28
: Um...is this...
lines.zh: : 嗯……这个是……

lines.en: : Who the fuck are you?
lines.zh: : 你他妈是谁？

lines.en: : A friend of...your ex-boyfriend’s...
lines.zh: : 我是……你前男友的朋友……

lines.en: : Is this really Niki Nakayama?
lines.zh: : 真的是 Niki Nakayama 吗？

lines.en: : Teehee~ Apologies, miss! That was my manager on the phone just now.
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻~ 抱歉啊，小姐！刚才是我的经纪人在电话里。

lines.en: : Would you mind putting your friend on the line for sec? There's something I need to talk to him about~
lines.zh: : 能让你朋友接一下电话吗？我有点事要跟他谈~

lines.en: scene saranikiboard29
: She, uhh...wants to talk to you...
lines.zh: : 她，呃……想跟你说话……

lines.en: : Hello?
: Are you still-
lines.zh: : 你还在——

lines.en: scene saranikiboard30
: Ah!
: You just...hung up on Niki...
lines.zh: : 你刚刚……把 Niki 的电话挂了……

lines.en: : This is what’s best for everyone.
lines.zh: : 这对所有人都好。

lines.en: scene saranikiboard31
: Do you believe me now?
lines.zh: : 你现在信我了吗？

lines.en: : You should have been able to recognize her voice if you know her, right?
lines.zh: : 你要是认识她，总该听得出她的声音吧？

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
: I’m...having sex with Niki Nakayama’s ex-boyfriend?...
lines.zh: : 我正在……和 Niki Nakayama 的前男友上床？……

lines.en: : Did I...Did I finally make it after all?
lines.zh: : 我……我终于出人头地了吗？

lines.en: else:
: It’s suddenly starting to make a lot more sense why you don’t like me the same way I like you.
lines.zh: : 突然就明白多了，为什么你不像我喜欢你那样喜欢我。

lines.en: scene black
Sara is a little too shocked to carry on hanging out after that.
lines.zh: 这之后 Sara 震惊得有点没法继续逛下去了。

lines.en: There’s also the fact that she needs to start getting ready for work, but it’s not like that’s ever stopped her before.
lines.zh: 另外她还得回去准备上班，不过这种事以前也从没拦住过她。

lines.en: All things considered, I think this was a pretty good afternoon.
lines.zh: 总的来说，这个下午过得相当不错。

lines.en: I got to learn a little more about Sara...and also got to make myself look a lot cooler than I actually am in the process.
lines.zh: 我多了解了一点 Sara……顺带还把自己衬得比实际酷了不少。

lines.en: Now, as long as Niki doesn’t-
lines.zh: 现在，只要 Niki 别——

lines.en: : I’ll just...
lines.zh: : 我就……

lines.en: : Read those later...
lines.zh: : 那些晚点再看吧……

lines.en: $ saradate10 = True
$ sara_love += 1
Sara’s affection has increased to [sara_love]!
lines.zh: Sara 的好感度提升到了 [sara_love]!

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
